_doc: Scooter, the quiet one with the tape recorder. Five cassettes labelled TOWER. Topics on the hub offer his quick fact (what's on tape four).

open.speaker: teen2
lines: Jody said don't talk to you. Jody's not the boss of the whole hill.
I've got a tape recorder. A real one, Panasonic, it was my dad's. I record stuff. That's all I do, I record stuff.
You can't do anything to a person for recording stuff.
Shoebox recorder, condenser mic taped to the handle. The kid's serious.

passives.line: Four fresh AAs in his jacket pocket, still on the card. He's not done recording. He's going back up, or he's afraid he'll have to.
'That's all I do.' He's apologising for the thing he's proudest of. Somebody laughed at the recorder.

static.line: Ask him to play it. He'll play it. It's still on the tape, and it knows the tape's in the house.

options.text: Nobody's laughing at the recorder, Scooter. What do you record?
Condenser mic. Did it pick up anything on those tapes your ears didn't?
Play us the end of tape four. Right now. We'll sit with you while it runs.
(Say nothing. Look at the recorder, not at him.)

records.speaker: teen2
lines: Trains. The river under the bridge approach. My grandma, before she... My grandma. And the tower. Five tapes.
Jody says I should've recorded the deputy. Jody says a lot.

hiss.speaker: teen2
lines: Cassette. ...There's a hum on all five tower tapes that isn't on the train tapes. Sounds like sixty cycles but it's not, it wobbles.
Dad says it's the tower pump. The tower doesn't have a pump. I checked. It's gravity.
Not mains. Not the pump. I want those tapes on a scope.

hiss_fail.speaker: teen2
lines: It's a cassette. It's just a cassette. Don't make it a thing.
Mr. Pace up the hill has real gear. Ask him what his gear does. Mine just records.

play.speaker: teen2
lines: (Hiss. Wind. Jody, far off: 'is it looking at us'. A clatter. Then, under the hiss, three notes. Three notes. He stops the tape.)
That part's new. The notes. That wasn't on it Friday. I've played it forty times, that wasn't on it.
It's not on the tape, Scooter. It's in the room.

play_fail.speaker: teen2
lines: No. No, I'm not playing it in the house. Not with... No.
Ask Jody. Jody heard it live. Jody can do the voice.

quiet.speaker: teen2
lines: It's a good recorder. Dad got it in Dayton. The heads are clean, I do them with a Q-tip.

hub.speaker: teen2
hub.prompt: Jody's gonna kill me. What else.
lines: Jody's gonna kill me. What else.

options.text: You said 'my grandma, before'. Before what, Scooter? What's on her tape?
Jody's already told us about the tape on the tree. You can stop protecting the joke.

grandma.speaker: teen2
lines: She was on the bridge in '67. In the line of cars. They pulled her out of the river. She never drove again and never said why till the tape.
On the tape she says there were birds on the cables that afternoon. Big ones, sitting. Then she asks me to turn it off. She died in March.
I didn't turn it off. I should've. I just wanted her voice.
She wanted it kept, Scooter. That's why she said it to a recorder and not to you.

grandma_fail.speaker: teen2
lines: That's my grandma. That's not... that's not tower stuff. Get out of my room.
Lyle on the ferry pulled people out in '67. Ask Lyle about birds. Don't ask me.
Leave it. He's fourteen and we just put his grandmother in the river in front of him.

joke.speaker: teen2
lines: ...It wasn't my joke. I held the flashlight. I held the flashlight and I recorded it, and that's the only reason anybody knows it stood up.
Jody says I dropped the recorder. I didn't drop it. I set it down. There's a difference.

batteries.speaker: teen2
lines: ...If it comes back I want it on tape. Nobody believed Jody. Everybody believes a tape.
No. Label it, date it, and don't go alone.
